privileged_info_for_vlm: The script must be located at /home/ga/Desktop/launch_kiosk.sh. It must use the username 'kiosk' and password 'Kiosk123!'. It must target the layout 'Lobby Monitor'. Required command-line flags for the Nx Witness client are '--auth', '--layout-name', and a fullscreen flag (e.g., '--full-screen', '--fullscreen', or '-fs').
